{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "SDS-PAGE Sample Prep", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Define liquids
    dye = protocol.define_liquid(name="dye", description="4x loading dye", display_color="#0000FF")
    samples = {}
    for i in range(1, 13):
        samples[f"sample {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"Sample {i}", display_color="#000000")
    
    # Load labware
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 1)
    dye_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 2)
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 3)
    
    # Load liquids into wells
    for i in range(1, 13):
        plate[f"A{i}"].load_liquid(liquid=samples[f"sample {i}"], volume=15)
    dye_plate["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=dye, volume=100)
    
    # Load pipette
    p300_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p300_multi_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Aspirate dye and dispense into sample wells
    p300_multi.pick_up_tip()
    p300_multi.aspirate(5, dye_plate["A1"])
    # dispense into each of the 12 wells individually
    p300_multi.dispense(5, plate["A1"])
    p300_multi.dispense(5, plate["A2"])
    p300_multi.dispense(5, plate["A3"])
    p300_multi.dispense(5, plate["A4"])
    p300_multi.dispense(5, plate["A5"])
    p300_multi.dispense(5, plate["A6"])
    p300_multi.dispense(5, plate["A7"])
    p300_multi.dispense(5, plate["A8"])
    p300_multi.dispense(5, plate["A9"])
    p300_multi.dispense(5, plate["A10"])
    p300_multi.dispense(5, plate["A11"])
    p300_multi.dispense(5, plate["A12"])
    p300_multi.drop_tip()"}

protocol.py: 4 biology problems (2 errors, 2 notes).

1. ERROR CONTAM-STOCK: A used tip went into a stock: dye (well A1 in slot 2)
   line 28:  p300.aspirate(5, dye_plate["A1"])
   At line 28 the tip went into dye (well A1 in slot 2) while it still carried sample 1
   (well A1 in slot 1), sample 2 (well A2 in slot 1), sample 3 (well A3 in slot 1), sample 4
   (well A4 in slot 1) and 7 more from an earlier step (this line did it 11 times). A tip
   that has touched one liquid leaves a little of it in the next liquid it touches, so this
   stock now holds material that does not belong there. Liquid drawn from it then took the
   unwanted material along into 11 other wells: wells A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, A9 and 3
   more in slot 1.
   Affected: well A1 in slot 2.
   Also reached 11 other wells: wells A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, A9 and 3 more in slot 1.
   Fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 28 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand
   out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids
   afterwards with a fresh tip each.
   Source: Lab Manager: minimizing cross-contamination in automated liquid handling
           https://www.labmanager.com/minimizing-cross-contamination-in-automated-liquid-handling-workflows-35194
   Source: WHO: dos and don'ts for molecular testing

   line did it 12 times). A pipette cannot measure less than its minimum: it draws the wrong
   amount, or nothing, and the volumes in this protocol only add up on paper. The simulator
